spl-token-cli 5.5.0
SPL-Token Command-line Utility

USAGE:
    spl-token [OPTIONS] <SUBCOMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -C, --config <PATH>
            Configuration file to use

        --fee-payer <KEYPAIR>
            Specify the fee-payer account. This may be a keypair file, the ASK keyword
            or the pubkey of an offline signer, provided an appropriate --signer argument
            is also passed. Defaults to the client keypair.

    -h, --help
            Print help information

        --output <FORMAT>
            Return information in specified output format [possible values: json, json-compact]

    -p, --program-id <ADDRESS>
            SPL Token program id

        --program-2022
            Use token extension program token 2022 with program id:
            TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb

    -u, --url <URL_OR_MONIKER>
            URL for Solana's JSON RPC or moniker (or their first letter): [mainnet-beta, testnet,
            devnet, localhost] Default from the configuration file.

    -v, --verbose
            Show additional information

    -V, --version
            Print version information

        --with-compute-unit-limit <COMPUTE-UNIT-LIMIT>
            Set compute unit limit for transaction, in compute units.

        --with-compute-unit-price <COMPUTE-UNIT-PRICE>
            Set compute unit price for transaction, in increments of 0.000001 lamports per compute
            unit.

    address

            Collect confidential tokens from pending to available balance

            Approve a delegate for a token account

            Get token account balance
    bench
            Token benchmarking facilities
    burn
            Burn tokens from an account
    close
            Close a token account
    close-mint
            Close a token mint
    configure-confidential-transfer-account
            Configure confidential transfers for token account
    create-account
            Create a new token account
    create-multisig
            Create a new account describing an M:N multisignature
    create-token
            Create a new token
    deposit-confidential-tokens
            Deposit amounts for confidential transfers

            Disable confidential transfers for token account
    disable-cpi-guard

            Disable non-confidential transfers for token account

    initialize-metadata

    set-transfer-fee

spl-token-create-token 
Create a new token

USAGE:
    spl-token create-token [OPTIONS] [--] [TOKEN_KEYPAIR]

ARGS:
    <TOKEN_KEYPAIR>    Specify the token keypair. This may be a keypair file or the ASK keyword.
                       [default: randomly generated keypair]

OPTIONS:
    -C, --config <PATH>
            Configuration file to use

        --decimals <DECIMALS>
            Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place [default: 9]

        --default-account-state <default_account_state>
            Specify that accounts have a default state. Note: specifying "initialized" adds an
            extension, which gives the option of specifying default frozen accounts in the future.
            This behavior is not the same as the default, which makes it impossible to specify a
            default account state in the future. [possible values: initialized, frozen]

        --enable-close
            Enable the mint authority to close this mint

        --enable-confidential-transfers <APPROVE-POLICY>
            Enable accounts to make confidential transfers. If "auto" is selected, then accounts are
            automatically approved to make confidential transfers. If "manual" is selected, then the
            confidential transfer mint authority must approve each account before it can make
            confidential transfers. [possible values: auto, manual]

        --enable-freeze
            Enable the mint authority to freeze token accounts for this mint

        --enable-group
            Enables group configurations in the mint. The mint authority must initialize the group.

        --enable-member
            Enables group member configurations in the mint. The mint authority must initialize the
            member.

        --enable-metadata
            Enables metadata in the mint. The mint authority must initialize the metadata.

        --enable-non-transferable
            Permanently force tokens to be non-transferable. They may still be burned.

        --enable-pause
            Enable the mint authority to pause mint, burn, and transfer for this mint

        --enable-permanent-delegate
            Enable the mint authority to be permanent delegate for this mint

        --enable-transfer-hook
            Enables the transfer hook in the mint. The mint authority can set the program id.

        --fee-payer <KEYPAIR>
            Specify the fee-payer account. This may be a keypair file, the ASK keyword
            or the pubkey of an offline signer, provided an appropriate --signer argument
            is also passed. Defaults to the client keypair.

        --group-address <ADDRESS>
            Specify address that stores token group configurations.

    -h, --help
            Print help information

        --interest-rate <RATE_BPS>
            Specify the interest rate in basis points. Rate authority defaults to the mint
            authority.

        --member-address <ADDRESS>
            Specify address that stores token member configurations.

        --metadata-address <ADDRESS>
            Specify address that stores token metadata.

        --mint-authority <ADDRESS>
            Specify the mint authority address. Defaults to the client keypair address.

        --multisig-signer [<MULTISIG_SIGNER>...]
            Member signer of a multisig account

        --nonce <PUBKEY>
            Provide the nonce account to use when creating a nonced
            transaction. Nonced transactions are useful when a transaction
            requires a lengthy signing process. Learn more about nonced
            transactions at https://docs.anza.xyz/cli/examples/durable-nonce

        --nonce-authority <KEYPAIR>
            Provide the nonce authority keypair to use when signing a nonced transaction

        --output <FORMAT>
            Return information in specified output format [possible values: json, json-compact]

    -p, --program-id <ADDRESS>
            SPL Token program id

        --program-2022
            Use token extension program token 2022 with program id:
            TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb

        --transfer-fee-basis-points <FEE_IN_BASIS_POINTS>
            Add transfer fee to the mint. The mint authority can set the fee.

        --transfer-fee-maximum-fee <MAXIMUM_FEE>
            Add a UI amount maximum transfer fee to the mint. The mint authority can set and collect
            fees

        --transfer-hook <TRANSFER_HOOK_PROGRAM_ID>
            Set a transfer hook program for this mint. The mint authority can set the program id.

    -u, --url <URL_OR_MONIKER>
            URL for Solana's JSON RPC or moniker (or their first letter): [mainnet-beta, testnet,
            devnet, localhost] Default from the configuration file.

        --ui-amount-multiplier <MULTIPLIER>
            Specify the UI multiplier. Multiplier authority defaults to the mint authority.

    -v, --verbose
            Show additional information

        --with-compute-unit-limit <COMPUTE-UNIT-LIMIT>
            Set compute unit limit for transaction, in compute units.

        --with-compute-unit-price <COMPUTE-UNIT-PRICE>
            Set compute unit price for transaction, in increments of 0.000001 lamports per compute
            unit.

        --with-memo <MEMO>
            Specify a memo string to include in the transaction.

spl-token-transfer 
Transfer tokens between accounts

USAGE:
    spl-token transfer [OPTIONS] <TOKEN_MINT_ADDRESS> <TOKEN_AMOUNT> <RECIPIENT_WALLET_ADDRESS or RECIPIENT_TOKEN_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS>

ARGS:
    <TOKEN_MINT_ADDRESS>
            Token to transfer

    <TOKEN_AMOUNT>
            Amount to send, in tokens; accepts keyword ALL

    <RECIPIENT_WALLET_ADDRESS or RECIPIENT_TOKEN_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS>
            If a token account address is provided, use it as the recipient. Otherwise assume the
            recipient address is a user wallet and transfer to the associated token account

OPTIONS:
        --allow-non-system-account-recipient
            Send tokens to the recipient even if the recipient is not a wallet owned by System
            Program.

        --allow-unfunded-recipient
            Complete the transfer even if the recipient address is not funded

        --blockhash <BLOCKHASH>
            Use the supplied blockhash

    -C, --config <PATH>
            Configuration file to use

        --confidential
            Send tokens confidentially. Both sender and recipient accounts must be pre-configured
            for confidential transfers.

        --dump-transaction-message
            Display the base64 encoded binary transaction message in sign-only mode

        --expected-fee <EXPECTED_FEE>
            Expected fee amount collected during the transfer

        --fee-payer <KEYPAIR>
            Specify the fee-payer account. This may be a keypair file, the ASK keyword
            or the pubkey of an offline signer, provided an appropriate --signer argument
            is also passed. Defaults to the client keypair.

        --from <SENDER_TOKEN_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS>
            Specify the sending token account [default: owner's associated token account]

        --fund-recipient
            Create the associated token account for the recipient if doesn't already exist

    -h, --help
            Print help information

        --mint-decimals <MINT_DECIMALS>
            Decimals of mint that token account is associated with. Required by --sign-only

        --multisig-signer [<MULTISIG_SIGNER>...]
            Member signer of a multisig account

        --no-recipient-is-ata-owner
            In sign-only mode, specifies that the recipient is the owner of the associated token
            account rather than an actual token account

        --no-wait
            Return signature immediately after submitting the transaction, instead of waiting for
            confirmations

        --nonce <PUBKEY>
            Provide the nonce account to use when creating a nonced
            transaction. Nonced transactions are useful when a transaction
            requires a lengthy signing process. Learn more about nonced
            transactions at https://docs.anza.xyz/cli/examples/durable-nonce

        --nonce-authority <KEYPAIR>
            Provide the nonce authority keypair to use when signing a nonced transaction

        --output <FORMAT>
            Return information in specified output format [possible values: json, json-compact]

        --owner <SENDER_TOKEN_OWNER_KEYPAIR>
            Specify the owner of the sending token account. This may be a keypair file or the ASK
            keyword. Defaults to the client keypair.

    -p, --program-id <ADDRESS>
            SPL Token program id

        --program-2022
            Use token extension program token 2022 with program id:
            TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb

        --sign-only
            Sign the transaction offline

        --signer <PUBKEY=SIGNATURE>
            Provide a public-key/signature pair for the transaction

        --transfer-hook-account [<PUBKEY:ROLE>...]
            Additional pubkey(s) required for a transfer hook and their role, in the format
            "<PUBKEY>:<ROLE>". The role must be "readonly", "writable". "readonly-signer", or
            "writable-signer".Used for offline transaction creation and signing.

    -u, --url <URL_OR_MONIKER>
            URL for Solana's JSON RPC or moniker (or their first letter): [mainnet-beta, testnet,
            devnet, localhost] Default from the configuration file.
